amendments.rationale: Owner reviewed all seventeen 03_THORACIC.md reviewer questions on 2026-07-30 and approved the corrections. STOP-SHIP findings addressed: vacuum-bottle and wall-suction therapeutic aspiration removed from thoracentesis in favour of manual syringe or gravity drainage per BTS 2023; the needle-decompression device specified as 14 gauge or larger with at least 8 cm usable length; the controlled-drainage stop-and-clamp rule added word-for-word identically to all three pleural records. MAJOR findings addressed: chest-tube caliber by indication with the record split so it owns large-bore and the pigtail owns small-bore; numeric massive-hemothorax activation triggers framed as a call rather than a threshold to wait for; drain-system safety including the never-clamp-a-bubbling-drain rule; single-dose-at-insertion antibiotic prophylaxis with the duration rule stated and the agent left to local protocol; pigtail dilation limited to the measured chest-wall depth with instability made an explicit exclusion per EAST 2021; needle-decompression landmarks reconciled to anterior axillary primary with the self-contradictory failed-needle pathway resolved by operator capability and a tube made the default; intercostal bundle order corrected from NAV to VAN in both places it was stated; pleural specimen handling corrected including removal of the SBP wording, both plain and blood-culture containers, and immediate pH analysis with lidocaine contamination called out; post-procedure imaging made selective per SHM 2018 while retaining immediate ultrasound; unsourced pneumothorax percentages removed. Owner decisions: pleural lidocaine takes the conservative BTS ceiling of 3 mg/kg to 250 mg rather than the FDA label figure, encoded as structured dosing with LAST rescue linkage; adult scope stated on all four. References replaced with the primary sources the lane report identified; thoracentesis previously cited the superseded 2010 BTS guideline it now complies with. A re-expansion pulmonary oedema rescue card was added and linked from all three pleural records.
amendments.followUp: reviewerStatus unchanged on all four procedures and on the chest-tube and thoracentesis kits: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md forbids an agent from setting it, and the owner promotes sign-offs through the app export and scripts/apply_local_reviews.py. Residual MINOR items: pigtail and chest-tube kit binding is scoped to stocked products rather than named per-product IFU revision, paediatric pathways are deferred by owner decision, and artwork remains pending on all four. The re-expansion rescue card is an AI draft awaiting clinical review.
